item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. Greater machine intelligence will not mean surrendering human authority.

2. We reject the idea that building superintelligent AI means handing over our future. If it arrives within the next 20 years, humans will remain fully in control. We will set the goals, establish the limits and retain the final say.

3. We see superintelligent AI as a tool, not a successor to human authority. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. Our future will be ours to direct.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. We reject the claim that greater intelligence automatically confers authority, or that technological progress requires us to surrender our decisions. We will set the purposes these systems serve, define the boundaries they operate within and retain the power to stop them. Our commitment is to a future in which extraordinary machine capabilities expand human possibilities without displacing human judgment. We embrace that future with confidence: we will build powerful tools, hold their developers accountable and keep humanity firmly in charge of what comes next.
